Every (episode, follower) pair is covered for $63.95 (6,395 cents). This is the lowest possible cost.

**Services that need nothing**
- **Pebble Kids:** no followed title is on it, so it can lapse on 2026-11-03.
- **Kestrel+:** the already-paid access, which ends 2026-11-04, does not reach the release on 11-24.

**Kestrel+ (The Distant Orchard, Mara)**
- All 10 episodes drop 2026-11-24. Mara's window runs 11-24 to 12-08.
- One period starting 2026-11-24 covers all 10 episodes. It costs $17.99.

**Orbit (The Amber Signal, Eli)**
- Episodes release weekly from 01-04 to 02-08. Eli's 7-day windows run from [01-04, 01-11] through [02-08, 02-15].
- One period starting 2027-01-11 gives access from 01-11 through 02-10.
  - Episode 1 is caught on 01-11, the last day of its window.
  - Episode 6 is caught on 02-08 to 02-10.
  - Every episode in between falls inside the period.
- It costs $10.99.

**Marquee (three titles)**
- The Crooked Tide (Eli, 7 days): windows run from episode 1 [01-19, 01-26] to episode 11 [03-30, 04-06].
- The Quiet Ferry (Mara, 14 days): windows run from episode 1 [01-22, 02-05] to episode 10 [03-26, 04-09].
- The Crooked Garden (both): all episodes drop 03-06. Eli's window ends 03-13 and Mara's ends 03-20.
- Coverage is needed from about late January to the end of March, which is more than one month. So at least two periods are required.
- **Period A starts 2027-01-26** and gives access from 01-26 through 02-25.
  - It catches Tide episode 1 on 01-26.
  - It catches Tide episode 6 (window 02-23 to 03-02) on 02-23 to 02-25.
- **Period B starts 2027-02-26** and gives access from 02-26 through 03-25.
  - It picks up Ferry episode 6 (window 02-26 to 03-12) and Tide episode 7 (window 03-02 to 03-09) without a gap.
  - It covers all of The Crooked Garden.
  - It reaches Tide episode 11 (window starts 03-30) and Ferry episode 10 (window starts 03-26).
- Together the two periods cost $27.98.

**Other rules**
- No period overlaps already-paid access or another period of the same service.
- All periods start within the plan dates.
- At most three non-required services have access on any day, so the limit of 3 is never exceeded.
